variants.headline: Party walks out of government
variants.body: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: A governing partnership breaks
variants.body: A governing party has left the colony's government. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.

variants.headline: Departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.body: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement. The gazette records the development as a matter deserving careful attention in the public interest.
